listing.name: Metroid Prime 3: Corruption / Corruption_3-PC (bonllavier)
listing.summary: Native Windows and Linux port of Metroid Prime 3: Corruption (Wii, USA) and Prime Trilogy built with static recompilation, no emulator. Play with keyboard and mouse or a gamepad, with PC visual upgrades and RetroAchievements (casual mode). Requires your own disc.
